Find the area (in square units) of $△ABC$ shown above.
question.worked_solution:
In this case, the area of the right triangle is

$$
A=\frac{1}{2}BC\cdot AB.
$$

We are given that $m∠A={30}^{∘}.$ Notice that relative to $∠A,$ we have expressions for the lengths of the opposite side $\overset{―}{BC}$ and adjacent side $\overset{―}{AB}.$ Hence, we can use the tangent ratio to solve for $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{tan}⁡(m∠A) & =\frac{BC}{AB} \\ \operatorname{tan}⁡({30}^{∘}) & =\frac{2x}{\sqrt{3}\,x+3} \\ \frac{\sqrt{3}}{3} & =\frac{2x}{\sqrt{3}\,x+3} \\ \sqrt{3}(\sqrt{3}\,x+3) & =3\cdot 2x \\ 3x+3\sqrt{3} & =6x \\ 3\sqrt{3} & =3x \\ x & =\sqrt{3}\end{aligned}
$$

So, the side lengths are 

$$
\begin{aligned}BC & =2x=2\sqrt{3}, \\ AB & =\sqrt{3}\,x+3=\sqrt{3}\,(\sqrt{3})+3=6.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the area of $△ABC$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot BC\cdot AB \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot 2\sqrt{3}\cdot 6 \\  & =6\sqrt{3}.\end{aligned}
$$
